# miao.my

MIAO 是适合中小企业的开源、可自托管工作台：说出需求、搭建应用、团队协作，定时任务自动处理重复工作。

站点地址：https://miao.my
内容语言：每页均为中英双语，客户端切换（默认中文，?lang=en 或页面按钮切换）。
本页由 scripts/gen-llms.py 自动生成并维护，每小时刷新。

## 页面

- [Changelog · MIAO](https://miao.my/content/layouts/changelog.en.html): MIAO release notes: shipped features, fixes and self-hosting impact.
- [更新日志 · MIAO](https://miao.my/content/layouts/changelog.zh.html): MIAO 版本更新日志：记录 MIAO 应用每次发布的功能、改进与修复。
- [Examples | Industry workspaces - MIAO](https://miao.my/content/layouts/examples.en.html): MIAO scenario examples: see how different teams can build their own workspace.
- [Examples｜行业工作台场景 - MIAO](https://miao.my/content/layouts/examples.zh.html): MIAO 行业场景示例：看看不同企业如何搭出自己的工作台。
- [MIAO product mockups](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes): Illustrative prototypes of the current MIAO workspace: sample data shows entry points, hierarchy and confirmation boundaries, from sign-in to daily work.
- [MIAO overview · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/01-overview.html): Start work from an app: the assistant drafts proposals whenever you need to create or change one in the MIAO workspace prototype.
- [Getting started · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/02-start.html)
- [Create an app · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/03-create.html): The assistant drafts in the panel on the right; the proposal stays reviewable before anything is written when creating a customer follow-up app.
- [Preview and publish · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/04-publish.html)
- [Daily work · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/05-work.html)
- [Change an app · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/06-change.html)
- [Data, files and exports · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/07-data.html): Search, paginate and correct data in this view while the assistant manages app structure and page changes in the MIAO workspace prototype.
- [Members and permissions · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/08-team.html)
- [Governance · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/09-governance.html)
- [Troubleshooting · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/10-troubleshoot.html)
- [Worked example · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/11-example.html)
- [Architecture · MIAO current product mockup](https://miao.my/docs/prototypes/12-architecture.html): Responsibilities across the browser, Go service, PocketBase and AI/Jev in the MIAO enterprise architecture prototype.
- [User Guide · MIAO](https://miao.my/docs/template.en.html): MIAO user guide: create workspaces, build apps with the AI assistant, run team workflows, manage permissions and govern data.
- [用户手册 · MIAO](https://miao.my/docs/template.html): MIAO 用户手册：从创建工作区、通过 Agent 建立应用，到团队使用、权限管理、数据治理与企业运营。
